title: Take the podium
text: One presenter faces the press outside city hall. Everyone else sees a silly secret on their phone. The presenter doesn’t!

scene.phone: You’re a raccoon elected mayor after promising unlimited bins.
scene.label: Reporters

title: Questions from the press
text: Reporters take turns asking questions aloud. The presenter improvises an answer. Then the reporter taps to pass the microphone.

title: Piece together the story
text: Guess who you are AND what you did, out loud. The current reporter confirms. Wrong? Keep going! Right? Reveal the secret and rotate presenters.
